description: For every first-order language and positive integer \(n\), the theory consisting of \(\delta_n\land\neg\delta_{n+1}\) has a model of exactly \(n\) elements.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Compactness.finite_model_exact_size.{u, v} (L : FirstOrder.Language) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
  ∃ M, Cardinal.mk ↑M = ↑n
